'''Jewelry Table''' is a {{Mastery|Red}}[[workstation]] that can be build in the [[Writing Room]].

Here, the [[Keeper]] can create zombie collars, [[tools]] to upgrade {{Mastery|Blue}}and {{Mastery|Violet}}, and other items.
